C1089.title: First Gaming Verdict: In-Game Player Poaching Ruled Unfair Competition
C1089.summary: In December 2022, the Wuxi Intermediate People's Court in Jiangsu ruled that game company B's use of guild shills to poach players from rival game A constituted unfair competition. The shills sent in-game messages with WeChat gift pack offers to lure high-value players into adding WeChat contacts, then disparaged the original game and redirected players to B's title.
